name: ParaBank QA Lab

type.display: Avenir Next, SF Pro Display, -apple-system, sans-serif
type.body: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

rules: Use direct section titles and evidence-first copy.
Use sentence case without artificial tracking.
Prefer spacing, type, tables, lists, and state rows over decorative card grids.
Do not use shadows, gradients, blur, or translucent navigation surfaces.
Keep each major section inside a flat bordered surface in both themes.
